prompt: Name one of the ten most recent US vice presidents.
label: Final Dig
source: US Senate, Vice Presidents of the United States: https://www.senate.gov/about/officers-staff/vice-president/vice-presidents.htm
valueLogic: Values track living memory. The four most recent are easy. Gore and Cheney are a decade back. Quayle and Bush are a generation. Mondale and Rockefeller are the tail - Rockefeller was never elected to either office and is the hardest name in the round.
note: 'George Bush' and 'Bush' credit George H. W. Bush. He was the only vice president named Bush, and in office he was simply George Bush, so that's a correct answer rather than an ambiguous one. 'George W Bush' and 'Dubya' hit the non-busting distractor.

answers.name: JD Vance
answers.fact: The sitting vice president, sworn in in January 2025.

answers.name: Kamala Harris
answers.fact: The first woman, and the first Black and South Asian American, to hold the office.

answers.name: Mike Pence
answers.fact: Served 2017 to 2021, and presided over the certification of his own defeat.

answers.name: Joe Biden
answers.fact: Vice president 2009 to 2017, and later president.

answers.name: Al Gore
answers.fact: Served 1993 to 2001, and cast four tie-breaking votes in the Senate.

answers.name: Dick Cheney
answers.fact: Served 2001 to 2009, and cast eight tie-breaking votes.

answers.name: George H. W. Bush
answers.fact: Reagan's vice president 1981 to 1989, then president.

answers.name: Dan Quayle
answers.fact: Served 1989 to 1993, at 41 one of the youngest to hold the office.

answers.name: Walter Mondale
answers.fact: Served 1977 to 1981, and the first vice president given an office in the West Wing.

answers.name: Nelson Rockefeller
answers.fact: Appointed under the 25th Amendment in 1974, and never elected vice president or president.

distractors.name: Gerald Ford
distractors.note: Vice president, but before Rockefeller - outside the ten most recent.

distractors.name: Spiro Agnew
distractors.note: Vice president until 1973, outside the ten most recent.

distractors.name: Lyndon Johnson
distractors.note: Vice president 1961-63, well outside the ten most recent.

distractors.name: Hubert Humphrey
distractors.note: Vice president 1965-69, outside the ten most recent.
